name: voice-id
description: Amazon Connect Voice ID provides real-time caller authentication and fraud risk detection, which make voice interactions in contact centers more secure and efficient.

subcommands.name: associate-fraudster
subcommands.description: Associates the fraudsters with the watchlist specified in the same domain.

subcommands.name: create-domain
subcommands.description: Creates a domain that contains all Amazon Connect Voice ID data, such as speakers, fraudsters, customer audio, and voiceprints.

subcommands.name: create-watchlist
subcommands.description: Creates a watchlist that fraudsters can be a part of.

subcommands.name: delete-domain
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified domain from Voice ID.

subcommands.name: delete-fraudster
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified fraudster from Voice ID.

subcommands.name: delete-speaker
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified speaker from Voice ID.

subcommands.name: delete-watchlist
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified watchlist from Voice ID.

subcommands.name: describe-domain
subcommands.description: Describes the specified domain.

subcommands.name: describe-fraudster
subcommands.description: Describes the specified fraudster.

subcommands.name: describe-fraudster-registration-job
subcommands.description: Describes the specified fraudster registration job.

subcommands.name: describe-speaker
subcommands.description: Describes the specified speaker.

subcommands.name: describe-speaker-enrollment-job
subcommands.description: Describes the specified speaker enrollment job.

subcommands.name: describe-watchlist
subcommands.description: Describes the specified watchlist.

subcommands.name: disassociate-fraudster
subcommands.description: Disassociates the fraudsters from the watchlist specified.

subcommands.name: evaluate-session
subcommands.description: Evaluates a specified session based on audio data accumulated during a streaming Amazon Connect Voice ID call.

subcommands.name: list-domains
subcommands.description: Lists all the domains in the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-fraudster-registration-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists all the fraudster registration jobs in the domain with the given JobStatus.

subcommands.name: list-fraudsters
subcommands.description: Lists all fraudsters in a specified watchlist or domain.

subcommands.name: list-speaker-enrollment-jobs
subcommands.description: Lists all the speaker enrollment jobs in the domain with the specified JobStatus.

subcommands.name: list-speakers
subcommands.description: Lists all speakers in a specified domain.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags associated with a specified Voice ID resource.

subcommands.name: list-watchlists
subcommands.description: Lists all watchlists in a specified domain.

subcommands.name: opt-out-speaker
subcommands.description: Opts out a speaker from Voice ID.

subcommands.name: start-fraudster-registration-job
subcommands.description: Starts a new batch fraudster registration job using provided details.

subcommands.name: start-speaker-enrollment-job
subcommands.description: Starts a new batch speaker enrollment job using specified details.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags a Voice ID resource with the provided list of tags.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes specified tags from a specified Amazon Connect Voice ID resource.

subcommands.name: update-domain
subcommands.description: Updates the specified domain.

subcommands.name: update-watchlist
subcommands.description: Updates the specified watchlist.
